notes.title: Puyo! Sokoban is out now! Launch discount: $2.00!
notes.notes:
The two games, Puyo! Push Brain and Puyo! Sokoban,
developed by SkyStudio and published by Liquid Meow games, 
are now officially available on STEAM. 
We hope these games can bring joy to everyone.

[h1]Puyo! Sokoban[/h1]
📦️ Puyo! Sokoban is a game that recreates a classic.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363640/_/
🎲 It features a GameBoy-style design, including numerous classic levels as well as some original ones. Players need to push boxes to designated positions to complete the level objectives.
[b]💰️ Price: $2.00 (original price $2.99, 33% off at launch) for 14 days.[/b]

[h1]Puyo! Push Brain[/h1]
🤔 Puyo! Push Brain is a game with creative gameplay.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336590/
🎲 It pays tribute to the classic GameBoy game Kwirk.
In the game, players need to push away obstacles, rotate fences, or push rocks into caves to build a path and ultimately reach the finish line.
[b]💰️ Price: $2.63 (original price $3.99, 34% off at launch) for 14 days.[/b]

Both games feature leaderboards and achievement systems.
Go for it! Strategists of the Puyo family, use your wisdom to win!

notes.title: "Puyo! Sokoban" is scheduled to launch on January 8th at 17:00 (UTC+8)!
notes.notes:
"Puyo! Sokoban" is a retro game jointly developed by SkyStudio and Liquid Meow Games. 
It combines the classic Sokoban gameplay with GameBoy-style graphics, featuring a variety of classic levels as well as some original ones.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363640/_/
This is a classic puzzle game that tests the player's logical thinking. Through the dazzling levels, players need to find the solutions and ultimately complete the game tasks. 
[b]Let's move forward together with the Puyo family!
[/b]-----------------------------------------------------
The protagonist, Fluffy, lives in an underground cave and can't stand the mess of boxes. Push the boxes to the smiling face position to complete the cave tidying.

[h1]Classic Game Screen with a Cute Character Makeover[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334968/43f4264b07bf06b84108ad11623ddd9bfd13986c.gif[/img]
The classic pixel-style screen, combined with GameBoy retro style and cute characters, will not cause excessive eye fatigue, bringing you a different Sliding Block experience.

[h1]Challenging Levels with Ingenious Level Design[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334968/0099a9f8d21126c5bdae2b8048f355ada62a37fe.gif[/img]
The difficulty of the levels increases step by step. Come and challenge yourself to see how far you can get! During the process, you may encounter situations where the boxes cannot be moved or are pushed into a dead end. Don't worry, just start over. The most important thing is to learn from mistakes, strive not to make the same mistakes next time, make full use of the limited space, arrange the order and position of movement reasonably, and ultimately pass the level.

[h1]Abundant Number of Levels for All-Round Challenges[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334968/c24e390064b820c673f001a6c92b090be1b399d3.gif[/img]
Abundant levels provide ample challenges and thinking opportunities. We have created nearly 100 interesting levels waiting for your challenge. Some levels may seem simple but could take you several hours or even longer. Some levels may seem complex, but as long as you are willing to take the first step and think carefully step by step, success is not far away.

[h1]Game Features[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Cute style, adorable characters, and a green theme that will not cause excessive eye fatigue.
[*] Comprehensive hints, when you are puzzled and even doubt there is no solution, you can freely get help in the game.
[*] Undo function, you can undo when you make a mistake.
[*] Leaderboard function, compete with global players in intelligence freely.
[/olist]
